workerPolicy: Choose smallest measured count reaching 90% of best independent-fit throughput, capped by current Windows/WSL headroom; at most six. Only two dependent model fits can execute concurrently.
continuationGate: All screen targets complete; at least one frozen long model scores at least 50% at both 80 and 300 ms. Development gate only; no superiority claim.
launchGates: fresh Windows and WSL resource check
fixed targets affordable using slower pilot costs
selection: Cost/quality Pareto guard with family diversity, then serial equal-time development games; finalist and targets frozen before independent confirmation
trainingPriority: Reuse existing training corpus and models; new diverse B/model-disagreement search preferences and independent exact labels; decision-quality checkpoint selection; no added pattern complexity
sourceAndModelIdentity: Frozen source snapshot and SHA-256 finalist; atomic checkpoints and immutable history chunks
screenDisposition: Inactive: the completed screen did not meet the predeclared continuation gate. No six-hour training launch is recommended.
